name: CounterPOS
desc: Retail billing counter: barcode and loose-weight items, GST receipts, UPI QR, khata credit, returns with credit notes, and a day-end till check.

name: KhataLite
desc: Digital udhaar ledger for customers and suppliers, WhatsApp reminders with a UPI link, a shareable statement page for customers, a cashbook and ageing reports.

name: TableTap
desc: QR table ordering with photos, a live kitchen display, table map, waiter calls, GST bills with service charge, and sales reports. Guest and kitchen screens sync live.

name: SalonDesk
desc: Stylist calendar, online booking that respects skills and breaks, GST billing, memberships and packages, client history and WhatsApp campaigns.

name: SchoolDesk
desc: Admissions, attendance, fee receipts, exams and report cards, timetables and notices, plus a parent portal for attendance, fees, results and UPI payment.

name: CoachDesk
desc: Enquiry pipeline, batches and seats, installment fee plans, attendance, tests with ranks, and a timetable planner that blocks teacher, room and batch clashes.

name: PayDesk
desc: Attendance grid, leave, payroll with PF, ESI and professional tax, payslips, advances, a bank transfer file and an employee app for punch-in and payslips.

name: ClinicDesk
desc: OPD token queue, patient records, a prescription writer with allergy warnings and printable letterhead, billing with UPI QR, follow-up reminders and reports.

name: RentDesk
desc: Bed-level occupancy, tenant records, monthly rent with UPI reminders and receipts, move-out settlement, complaints, expenses by property and a tenant app.

name: SocietyHub
desc: Maintenance billing, a gate screen with resident-approved visitors, complaints, notices and polls, facility booking, accounts and a resident app.

name: FixTrack
desc: Job cards, a repair board by stage, customer estimate approval, parts stock, GST invoices, warranty claims and WhatsApp updates.

name: GiveTrack
desc: Public donation page with UPI, instant 80G receipts, donor records, campaigns with progress, monthly giving, utilisation reports and a donor-wise statement.

name: LeadNest
desc: Lead pipeline for service businesses: a web enquiry form that feeds the board, daily follow-ups, shareable quotations the client can accept, and win and loss reports.

name: FilePilot
desc: Compliance tracker for CA firms: GST, TDS, PF, advance tax, ITR and ROC due dates per client, a filings board, WhatsApp document reminders and a client upload portal.
